packMeta.name: Curated Snooker Routine Library v1
packMeta.author: Snooker Practice PWA
packMeta.description: A compact curated snooker training library with level-based targets, skill maps, transfer tags, and productive-difficulty target profiles for club to advanced players.
packMeta.recommendedUse: Import as catalogue routines, then duplicate/edit personal copies where needed.

routines.setupDescription: Hit reds and bring cue ball behind/near baulk line; count successful leaves.

routines.setupDescription: Attempt pot with cue ball finishing safe behind baulk if missed.

routines.setupDescription: Use side/pace to travel figure-eight route and return safe.

routines.name: Thin-contact safety

routines.setupDescription: Thin contact on object ball, cue ball to baulk/side cushion safe zone.

routines.name: One-cushion escape

routines.setupDescription: Escape a simple snooker using one cushion and finish safe.

routines.name: Two-cushion escape

routines.setupDescription: Escape using two cushions; count legal contact plus safe result.

routines.name: Covering reds safety
routines.description: Leave object balls covered while cue ball finishes safe; count tactical success.
routines.setupDescription: Leave object balls covered while cue ball finishes safe; count tactical success.

routines.name: Safety mini-frame drill
routines.description: Play ten safety exchanges against a target leave quality; count wins/strong leaves.
routines.setupDescription: Play ten safety exchanges against a target leave quality; count wins/strong leaves.

routines.name: Must-pot black pressure
routines.description: 10 black-ball pots under full pre-shot routine; miss resets mental count.
routines.setupDescription: 10 black-ball pots under full pre-shot routine; miss resets mental count.

routines.name: Last red and colour
routines.description: Last red plus colour under match routine; count successful red-colour conversion.
routines.setupDescription: Last red plus colour under match routine; count successful red-colour conversion.

routines.name: Frame-winning colours
routines.description: Start on yellow/green/brown/blue/pink/black sequence; count successful frame-winning attempts.
routines.setupDescription: Start on yellow/green/brown/blue/pink/black sequence; count successful frame-winning attempts.

routines.name: One-chance line-up
routines.description: Only one attempt per setup; record highest break to simulate frame opportunity.
routines.setupDescription: Only one attempt per setup; record highest break to simulate frame opportunity.

routines.name: Comeback safety under pressure
routines.description: After a forced miss scenario, play best safety recovery; count strong tactical outcomes.
routines.setupDescription: After a forced miss scenario, play best safety recovery; count strong tactical outcomes.

routines.name: Focus reset routine
routines.description: Simple potting set where every shot requires full reset routine; count execution quality.
routines.setupDescription: Simple potting set where every shot requires full reset routine; count execution quality.

routines.name: Long blue with rest
routines.description: Long blue pots using the rest; alternate sides.
routines.setupDescription: Long blue pots using the rest; alternate sides.

routines.name: Rest pot and hold position
routines.description: Pot with rest and hold cue ball within a positional zone.
routines.setupDescription: Pot with rest and hold cue ball within a positional zone.

routines.name: Recovery from wrong side
routines.description: Start wrong side of colour and recover to next natural potting position.
routines.setupDescription: Start wrong side of colour and recover to next natural potting position.

routines.name: Fatigue maintenance potting
routines.description: Simple mid-range potting late in session; maintain cueing under fatigue.
routines.setupDescription: Simple mid-range potting late in session; maintain cueing under fatigue.

routines.name: Confidence builder routine
routines.description: High-probability pots to rebuild rhythm and confidence after difficult blocks.
routines.setupDescription: High-probability pots to rebuild rhythm and confidence after difficult blocks.

routines.name: Match shot-selection review drill
routines.description: For 12 realistic positions, choose and execute best match shot; count tactically correct choices.
routines.setupDescription: For 12 realistic positions, choose and execute best match shot; count tactically correct choices.

routines.name: Break-off and first visit
routines.description: Play a break-off, then continue from the resulting position and score whether the first visit produced a useful scoring chance or strong control.
routines.setupDescription: Start from a normal break-off. After the break, play the first realistic visit from the table you leave yourself.
routines.trainingIntent: Bridge technical opening shots into match-realistic first-visit decision making.

routines.name: Two-shot match sequence
routines.description: Set a realistic red-colour or red-position sequence and count success only when both the pot and position are achieved.
routines.setupDescription: Use a realistic table layout: awkward red, available colour, and a defined positional zone for the second shot.
routines.trainingIntent: Train conversion from one realistic opportunity into the next shot rather than isolated potting.

routines.name: Frame-ball pressure pot
routines.description: One pressure pot to win or protect the frame. Count only clean execution under the pre-shot routine.
routines.setupDescription: Place the cue ball awkwardly and nominate a frame-ball pot. Reset fully after each attempt.
routines.trainingIntent: Build pressure stability and decision quality on shots that matter.

routines.name: Snooker escape + safe leave
routines.description: Escape a snooker and leave the cue ball or object ball safe. A simple hit is not enough: the leave must also be defensible.
routines.setupDescription: Cue ball snookered behind a colour; object ball visible only via cushion escape. Define a safe baulk or distance leave.
routines.trainingIntent: Connect escape-shot mechanics with match-quality safety outcomes.

routines.name: Rest under pressure
routines.description: Five rest pots from awkward positions under a simple time or routine constraint. Count only clean pots with controlled cueing.
routines.setupDescription: Use the rest from realistic awkward angles. Keep the setup compact and reset fully between attempts.
routines.trainingIntent: Move rest play from pure mechanics into pressure-context execution.

routines.name: Cue-ball pace ladder — zone points
routines.description: Score positional control with partial credit: 5 points exact zone, 3 points within one foot, 1 point usable leave, 0 otherwise.
routines.setupDescription: Play cue-ball pace routes to pre-defined landing zones. Use points rather than binary success to capture quality.
routines.trainingIntent: Give finer feedback on pace control than success/fail scoring.

routines.name: Baulk-line control — zone points
routines.description: Score safety control with partial credit: 5 exact baulk zone, 3 safe distance, 1 thin-contact leave, 0 poor leave.
routines.setupDescription: Use baulk-line or containing-safety layouts with pre-defined cue-ball/object-ball zones.
routines.trainingIntent: Measure safety quality and cue-ball control with graded outcomes.
